title: Bounded tolerant import of historical LibreCAD AC1021 table-body handle roles

scope.historicalWriter: LibreCAD bundled libdxfrw ENC writer profile, as recorded in p4-libreCAD-historical-control-read-profile-2026-11-05.json
changes: AC1021 LAYER lineType accepts the observed code-4 soft pointer for tolerant parsing and retains the original field span/role.
AC1021 BLOCK_HEADER block, ownedEntity, and endBlock fields accept observed code-4 soft pointers for tolerant parsing and retain each field span/role.
AC1021 BLOCK_HEADER layout accepts the observed null code-3 hard-ownership form; non-null code-3 targets remain rejected.
Integrity diagnostics preserve the object handle and expected/observed role; the parsed BLOCK_HEADER spans retain field names and raw role codes.
scope.strictOutput: All observed role mismatches remain integrity errors; strict-complete conversion refuses before replacing the caller destination.

blockHeaderLayout.disposition: tolerated as the observed null historical form

outputRefusal.reason: strict-complete conversion requires successful, complete DWG read disposition

relatedBroaderChecks: The general AC1021/AC1024/AC1027 DWG fixture executable remains red on its pre-existing non-AC1021 profiles; the targeted AC1021 CLI refusal control passes.

The broader --source-disposition-only CLI selector reaches a separate generated AC1032 HEADER-emission readback failure after the historical AC1021 case passes; this slice has its own isolated fast CTest.

limits: Role relaxation is version-gated to AC1021 and field-gated to the observed slots; it does not claim ODA-conforming handle roles.
The integrity projection itself is bounded to 16 rows and reports its nine-row omission count; strict output remains refused.
No testing DWG/DXF fixture was added or modified.
This change establishes bounded read compatibility only. It does not establish complete source-to-DXF graph closure, independent semantics, consumer qualification, or format support parity.
